title: Impact of Suspension of Boeing 737 Max Aircraft
what_it_is: Impact of Suspension of Boeing 737 Max Aircraft

sections.label: Boeing 737 Max suspension
sections.summary: CAAS suspended all Boeing 737 Max variants into and out of Singapore on 12 March 2019, pending safety concerns.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In aviation, ensuring the safety of passengers and crew is paramount.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This is why the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) suspended operations of all variants of the Boeing 737 Max aircraft into and out of Singapore on 12 March 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: CAAS will only lift the suspension when it is fully satisfied that all safety concerns relating to the aircraft type have been adequately addressed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: During the suspension, CAAS will not allow airlines to register new Boeing 737 Max aircraft.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is currently no evidence of safety issues with other Boeing aircraft.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: CAAS has been communicating closely with Boeing and the United States' Federal Aviation Authority (FAA), as well as other regulators, including the European Union Aviation Safety Agency, on the safety issues of the Boeing 737 Max aircraft.

sections.label: SilkAir 737 Max grounding
sections.summary: SilkAir's six Boeing 737 Max aircraft were grounded, causing cancelled or adjusted flights affecting about 300 passengers a day.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: With the suspension, SilkAir's fleet of six Boeing 737 Max aircraft have been grounded.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: SilkAir had to cancel or adjust some flights, affecting about 300 passengers a day.

sections.label: Airlines maintain normal operations
sections.summary: Airlines with limited Singapore services kept normal operations using other aircraft, except Shandong Airlines, which suspended its Singapore operations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As they have limited services to Singapore, they have been able to maintain normal operations using other aircraft types, except for Shandong Airlines which has had to suspend its operations to Singapore.
